description: According to the Illinois State Board of Education, only 31 out of 100 of Illinois students were proficient in English Language Arts in 2025—meaning two out of every three students were not proficient.

title: “Only 1 in 3 Illinois Students Can Read at Grade Level. Why Aren't We Fixing It?”
